start_here: Say to your AI: "Make a sound effect from a description of the sound", giving the fields its input names. It makes the files and keeps each as a new file in your files; a recording itself is never changed. It needs the connection or the local model the style names before it can make anything.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input, makes files, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make a sound effect from a description of the sound", and give it the fields the input names.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-sound-effect and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. If it says a connection or a model is missing, connect it or give its folder, then run it again. Read the files it kept in your files.
